en.headline: Clinton evacuated: reception centre open in Kamloops
en.body: The entire Village of Clinton has been evacuated because of the Pear Lake wildfire. A reception centre for evacuees is open at the McArthur Island Sport and Event Centre in Kamloops. Smoke in Kamloops is a very high health risk. Follow directions from local authorities.
